name: Louisiana

period.description: Spend-down coverage for people living at home lasts no more than three months, starting no earlier than the day you meet the spend-down.

submission.description: Give your medical bills to Louisiana Medicaid. Bills are applied oldest first, and hospital bills are used before doctor bills.

notes: Unpaid bills generally must be for care within three months before the month you applied.
Health insurance premiums, such as Medicare, are subtracted from your income first.
Home and community-based waiver spend-down has different, longer periods; ask LDH.
